title: Object Portal
description: An object portal effect treats a prop as a wormhole: a bag, a screen, or a doorway that should not lead there, opening onto another space. The thing is the cut.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: A filing cabinet leads to a tunnel. A mirror becomes a corridor.
A phone swallows a body. Use it when geography must jump through an object we already believe in as a prop.
It is the wrong tool when the camera itself punches through a wall with no special object, or when a wall is only a screen of light. If matter is optional for the lens, that is a pass-through.
If pictures crawl on architecture, that is a projection.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Photograph the prop as a real object with thickness, rim, and a key. Composite or project the far space inside its opening.
Parallax the rim against the interior so the hole has depth. The room around the prop stays this world.
Hands, edges, and contact shadows sell the aperture. Prompt an object portal through the subject: a thing opening onto another space, a bag, a screen, a doorway that should not lead there.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for the beat when a character climbs into a prop and arrives somewhere the room cannot contain. Do not use it as a generic glow around a door that is just a door.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a glowing doorway or a Pass Through through a wall. The tell is no prop with thickness, or the whole set melting.
The fix is a readable object, a hole with parallax, and two geographies meeting at the rim.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is an object portal in film?
An object portal treats a prop as a wormhole. A bag, screen, or doorway opens onto another space that the room should not contain. The object is the cut.
Object portal vs pass through
A pass-through sends the camera through a wall or body as if matter were optional. An object portal requires a thing with a rim: the far world is inside that object.
When should I use object portal?
Use it when a character or look must travel through a prop into another space. Skip it when you only need to fly the camera through architecture.
How do I prompt object portal for AI image or video?
Write Object portal through [Subject], a thing opening onto another space. Name the prop, its thickness, and the geography inside the opening. Keep the outer room stable.
